title: The power path
alt: A face-on section that follows the power: a cable from the street vault runs under the yard to a pad-mounted transformer, into the electrical room through the switchgear and the UPS with its batteries, and along a busway over the row of racks.
sources: SPEC transformer: Eaton CA08104001E (Apr 2016) p. 17.0-18, Table 17.0-13, 2,500 kVA
SPEC switchgear: Siemens Type WL (Siemens Canada catalogue s. 12), 32 in wide, 96 in high
SPEC ups: Schneider Galaxy VX 1000 kW (990-5451L-001), 3600 x 900 x 1970 mm
SPEC battery: Vertiv EnergyCore Li5 (SL-71271 R06/26), 600 x 750 x 2000 mm
SPEC rack: Vertiv VR3300, 600 x 1200 x 2000 mm
placeholders: low voltage after the transformer [n] V
camera: face-on section; the camera tracks along the cable

steps.caption: Power comes in from the grid.
The transformer steps the voltage down for the building.
Switchgear splits the power and protects each circuit.
The UPS and its batteries keep the racks on if the grid drops.
Power runs overhead to each rack.
